text_zh: 杭州政协网转载的2023年8月7日《每日商报》报道，将岳王庙列为每天开放、全年开放的场馆；据此记录普通每周无固定闭馆日。去哪儿的整体岳王庙主记录在入园信息中另列需提前预约，本条据这一平台说明记录预约要求；该页未标资料独立更新时间，不冒园方现行确认，不认证页面未具名公众号或护照线上字段。最少提前多久、可选购票窗口均未核定，不把需提前预约写成必须提前一天或保证有票。较早门户报道和商业平台资料不保证当天、每个设施或临时展厅均开放，行前另查最新安排。内部岳飞纪念馆、普通西湖湖岸、团体、优惠资格及平台套餐规则不代替本条普通整馆范围。
text_en: A Meiri Shangbao report dated 7 August 2023, republished on Hangzhou’s CPPCC portal, describes Yue Fei Temple as opening daily throughout the year, supporting no fixed ordinary weekly closure here. Qunar’s whole-temple main record separately states advance reservation is required under admission information; this entry records that platform guidance. It has no independent data-update date and is not confirmation of the operator’s current policy, an unnamed WeChat account or passport support online. Minimum lead time and an optional purchase window remain unconfirmed: advance booking does not establish a one-day minimum or ticket availability. The older portal report and commercial platform information do not guarantee access that day or to every facility or temporary exhibition. Check current arrangements before travelling. Internal museum, public lakeshore, group, concession and package rules do not replace this ordinary whole-temple scope.
